# vendor/

Place a known-good exact-machine configuration here:

```text
vendor/elegoo.txt
```

Use a Neptune 2 + Robin Nano v1.2 baseline matching the machine's installed
hardware (manual leveling vs probe, etc.).

The toolkit patches only Wi-Fi directives.

Do not blindly substitute Neptune 2S, Neptune 2D, Robin Nano v1.3, or a
different bed-level/probe configuration.
